title: 10/02 — Employers, firms, clients, financial institutions (one entity list, roles decided by the field)
consumer: the same injected gazetteer lookup as 01-schools; hits enter §3.7 ranking as candidates for whichever org-role field's context rule passes. The gazetteer never records role.
backs_fields_note: The §3.8 role split, applied to organizations: `our_firm` and `client` are two fields over one entity type (role_split in CONNECTION.md section 6), and Finance's `institution` (the issuing bank) is a third role the same entity list can back. VERIFIED against planning/domains/canonical_fields.json (R1a landed after this file was first drafted): all three keys resolve and carry `gazetteer: "orgs"`. R1a also tags `lab` and `venue` with `gazetteer: "orgs"` — the seam with 03-research-venues.json is recorded there (unc-r1a-gazetteer-tag) and in RESEARCH.md. One gazetteer backs all three role fields; the row never says which role an org plays — the field's context rule does. The Career schema's company field is DEFERRED (D1, narrowed: no career field rows; 04-resolutions.md S3) — canonical_fields.json confirms no such key exists yet. When Joseph authors it, owed before P10, this gazetteer backs it too; naming it here now would mint the field by the back door.

backs_fields_cites.quote: distinct facets, such as authored_by and target_school, or our_firm and client
an account holder and an issuing bank
Finance files may use institution, account type, tax year, and record type

universe: design_examples — v1 contains only organizations the design itself names. There is no honest complete universe for 'employers and clients': they are user-specific by nature (§3.12: values auto-create) and 'every company on earth' is refused outright. The one bounded sub-universe worth considering is a national register of regulated financial institutions for the Finance `institution` field — a jurisdiction fork (D4 'which one'), recorded under uncertain.

why.quote: It should use word-boundary matching rather than substring matching.

match_rule.case_rule: per alias: name aliases case-insensitive; acronym aliases case-sensitive
match_rule.cjk_matcher_slot: same slot as 01-schools: named `cjk_matcher`, unfilled in v1; per-alias `script` keeps CJK rows representable without a schema change

injected_slots.note: §3.7's thresholds, injected. No number lives in this file.

never_alone.rule: an org-gazetteer hit alone fills no field, activates no schema, and creates no group — the design's Columbia sentence is about entity ambiguity generally, and a firm name is exactly as role-ambiguous as a university name

cite.quote: A university name alone should not create a group because Columbia can appear as an authoring school, course provider, target institution, employer, research venue, or merely a cited organization.

entries.notes: The design's one named commercial organization (a career packet label). Canonical is 'EY' — the firm's actual brand name — with the legacy long forms as aliases; the expansion is inference. The two-letter acronym is case-sensitive; word-boundary keeps it out of 'MONEY' and 'journey' regardless.

refused.refuses: importing NAICS or any industry-classification code table
refused.reason: The dispatch brief forbids it, and an industry code is a category, not an organization name — importing one rebuilds the industry taxonomy ALIGNMENT.md forbids.

refused.refuses: every GitHub organization / a code-hosting namespace dump
refused.reason: Unbounded, spam-heavy, and code-project identity is P3/P5's repository-marker territory (catalogue 05), not a name gazetteer.
No stated universe, maximal homonym surface. A filtered, bounded slice with a stated selection rule could return via uncertain; a dump cannot.

refused.refuses: recording a role (employer / client / our-firm) on a gazetteer row
refused.reason: Role is the field's, never the entity's. The same firm is `our_firm` in one engagement and `client` in another; a row that fixed the role would contradict §3.8's split.

design_cite.quote: distinct facets, such as authored_by and target_school, or our_firm and client

refused.refuses: duplicating universities into this file because they can be employers
refused.reason: One entity, one row, one file. A schools-gazetteer hit may back an org-role field when that field's context rule passes; duplicating rows across files would create the cross-file alias collisions check.py exists to prevent.

design_cite.quote: Columbia can appear as an authoring school, course provider, target institution, employer, research venue, or merely a cited organization

refused.refuses: person names as org rows (sole traders, 'Jane Chen Consulting' style guesses)
refused.reason: Same refusal as 01-schools ref-person-names: person-name matching at corpus scale is the MIT-in-submit failure class, and authorship must not drive placement.

uncertain.question: Does a national register of regulated financial institutions back Finance's `institution` in v1?
uncertain.note: The one org sub-universe that is genuinely bounded and official (for the US, the FDIC's BankFind institution directory; for the UK, the FCA register). Jurisdiction-dependent — D4 is ratified as one-jurisdiction-injected but WHICH one is open, and this is the same fork as 01-schools unc-v1-universe. Until it lands, `institution` values arrive via labeled sources (direct), user entry (user_confirmed), or stay possible. NEEDS-JOSEPH.

uncertain.question: Should v1 ship any employer/client list beyond user-add?
uncertain.note: Employers and clients are the most user-specific entity type in the product. The design's mechanism for them is §3.12's value auto-creation plus user confirmation, and a shipped list adds mostly homonym risk (every common surname is a firm somewhere). Plausible resolution: ship none; let repeated user-approved values become the user's own gazetteer (see PROCEDURE.md, user-add lifecycle). NEEDS-JOSEPH.

uncertain.question: When the Career schema's fields land (D1: owed before P10), which key does this gazetteer back?
uncertain.note: §5.4's Career template names 'company' as a dimension in prose; no field row exists yet and none may be written now. Recorded so the seam is visible to R1a and to whoever authors the career fields.
